hook: Imagine asking your health records instead of searching through PDFs.
caption: Searching through PDFs means open, scroll, squint, close. What if you could just ask? Ask how you slept this week, and the matching record opens right where it matters, with the date and context around it. Wellness information, not a diagnosis. Ask your records. #HealthGraph #AskYourRecords #HealthRecords #HealthData #DigitalHealth #SelfTracking #PersonalHealth #DocumentSearch

lines.text: Imagine asking your health records instead of searching through PDFs.
lines.beat: a stack of generic PDF documents; a cursor hovers over an empty search field

lines.text: Searching is open, scroll, squint, close.
lines.beat: documents open and close rapidly: open, scroll, squint, close
the documents step aside; a chat input fades in

lines.text: Open the chat. Type a question.
lines.beat: real ai-chat screen; the input field Ask about your health stays in view

lines.text: How did I sleep this week?
lines.beat: the suggested chip How did I sleep this week is tapped in the ai-chat screen

lines.text: The answer lands with the records behind it.
lines.beat: an answer card expands in the chat; the source references in it glow

lines.text: The matching record opens, already at the right place.
lines.beat: the daily-report card opens, already at the right section, 3 OCT in view

lines.text: You see the context: date, measurements, notes around it.
lines.beat: context panel around the entry: date, adjacent entries, and the patterns-sleep chart 420 min steady
the small line Wellness info only, Not medical advice rests calm in frame
end card: chat with a calm blinking cursor, CTA over the dimmed ai-chat screen
